headline: A 2019 executive order sets a federal policy goal of keeping the United States a leader in artificial intelligence.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order makes US leadership in artificial intelligence (AI) a goal of the federal government. Executive orders like this one usually tell federal agencies how to set priorities and use their resources. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, programs, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are likely directed to make AI a priority in their work, though the exact duties are not stated in the material provided.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 11, 2019; the effective date was not stated in the material provided.
